cd /tmp/videos/vid_5e8d39727c286702 && python - <<'EOF'
from ultralytics import YOLO
import csv, collections
m = YOLO("yolov8s.pt")
res = m.track(source="vid_5e8d39727c286702.mp4", tracker="bytetrack.yaml", classes=[0],
              conf=0.12, imgsz=1920, persist=True, stream=True, verbose=False)
rows=[]
for i,r in enumerate(res):
    if r.boxes is None or r.boxes.id is None: 
        continue
    for b,tid in zip(r.boxes, r.boxes.id.tolist()):
        x1,y1,x2,y2 = b.xyxy[0].tolist()
        rows.append((i, int(tid), round(float(b.conf),3), round(x1),round(y1),round(x2),round(y2)))
print("total dets", len(rows))
w=csv.writer(open("tracks_pred.csv","w",newline=""))
w.writerow(["frame","track_id","conf","x1","y1","x2","y2"]); w.writerows(rows)
c=collections.Counter(r[1] for r in rows)
print("per track count:", dict(c))
for tid in sorted(c):
    fr=[r for r in rows if r[1]==tid]
    print(tid, "frames %d-%d"%(fr[0][0],fr[-1][0]), "n=",len(fr), "first box",fr[0][3:], "last box",fr[-1][3:], "conf avg", round(sum(f[2] for f in fr)/len(fr),3))
EOF

import csv, cv2, numpy as np, subprocess, collections

SRC="vid_5e8d39727c286702.mp4"
OUT="tracked_person_yolov8_bytetrack.mp4"
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open("tracks_final.csv")))
by_frame=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    by_frame[int(r["frame"])].append((int(r["track_id"]),float(r["conf"]),
                                      int(r["x1"]),int(r["y1"]),int(r["x2"]),int(r["y2"])))
cap=cv2.VideoCapture(SRC)
W=int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH)); H=int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
FPS=cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS); N=int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
print(W,H,FPS,N)

ff=subprocess.Popen(["ffmpeg","-y","-f","rawvideo","-pix_fmt","bgr24","-s",f"{W}x{H}",
    "-r",str(FPS),"-i","-","-an","-c:v","libx264","-preset","medium","-crf","20",
    "-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-movflags","+faststart",OUT],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

GREEN=(60,255,60); AMBER=(40,190,255); WHITE=(255,255,255); BLACK=(0,0,0)
INSET_W, INSET_H = 512, 288
M=18

def draw_box(img,b,color,t,label=None,scale=0.6):
    x1,y1,x2,y2=b
    cv2.rectangle(img,(x1,y1),(x2,y2),color,t)
    L=max(10,int(min(x2-x1,y2-y1)*0.35))
    for (cx,cy,dx,dy) in ((x1,y1,1,1),(x2,y1,-1,1),(x1,y2,1,-1),(x2,y2,-1,-1)):
        cv2.line(img,(cx,cy),(cx+dx*L,cy),color,t+1)
        cv2.line(img,(cx,cy),(cx,cy+dy*L),color,t+1)
    if label:
        (tw,th),_=cv2.getTextSize(label,cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,scale,2)
        ty=max(y1-th-8,0); tx=max(x1-1,0)
        cv2.rectangle(img,(tx,ty),(tx+tw+8,ty+th+8),color,-1)
        cv2.putText(img,label,(tx+4,ty+th+2),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,scale,BLACK,2)

for i in range(N):
    ok,fr=cap.read()
    if not ok: break
    dets=by_frame.get(i,[])
    # ---------- inset (zoom) panel ----------
    panel=np.zeros((INSET_H,INSET_W,3),np.uint8)
    if dets:
        tid,conf,x1,y1,x2,y2=max(dets,key=lambda d:(d[4]-d[2])*(d[5]-d[3]))
        bw,bh=x2-x1,y2-y1
        cx,cy=(x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2
        cw=max(bw*3.2,90); ch=max(bh*1.9,90)
        ar=INSET_W/INSET_H
        if cw/ch<ar: cw=ch*ar
        else: ch=cw/ar
        sx1=int(max(cx-cw/2,0)); sy1=int(max(cy-ch/2,0))
        sx2=int(min(cx+cw/2,W)); sy2=int(min(cy+ch/2,H))
        if sx2-sx1<8 or sy2-sy1<8: sx1,sy1,sx2,sy2=0,0,W,H
        crop=fr[sy1:sy2,sx1:sx2]
        if crop.size:
            panel=cv2.resize(crop,(INSET_W,INSET_H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
            s=INSET_W/(sx2-sx1)
            nb=[int((x1-sx1)*s),int((y1-sy1)*s),int((x2-sx1)*s),int((y2-sy1)*s)]
            draw_box(panel,nb,GREEN,2)
        # main frame box
        draw_box(fr,(x1,y1,x2,y2),GREEN,3,f"PERSON ID {tid}  {conf:.2f}")
        status=f"ID {tid} tracked  conf {conf:.2f}"
        stcol=GREEN
    else:
        panel[:]=(30,30,30)
        cv2.putText(panel,"no detection (occluded)",(14,INSET_H//2),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.7,(140,140,140),2)
        status="ID 1 temporarily lost / occluded"
        stcol=AMBER

    # ---------- HUD ----------
    ov=fr.copy()
    cv2.rectangle(ov,(0,0),(760,74),(0,0,0),-1)
    fr=cv2.addWeighted(ov,0.55,fr,0.45,0)
    cv2.putText(fr,"YOLOv8s + ByteTrack  |  person tracking",(16,32),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.8,(0,255,255),2)
    cv2.putText(fr,f"frame {i+1:03d}/{N}   t={i/FPS:5.2f}s",(16,62),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.6,WHITE,2)
    # status strip bottom-left
    (tw,th),_=cv2.getTextSize(status,cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.62,2)
    cv2.rectangle(fr,(0,H-th-26),(tw+24,H),(0,0,0),-1)
    cv2.putText(fr,status,(12,H-10),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.62,stcol,2)
    # inset placement bottom-right
    px1,py1=W-INSET_W-M, H-INSET_H-M
    fr[py1:py1+INSET_H, px1:px1+INSET_W]=panel
    cv2.rectangle(fr,(px1-2,py1-2),(px1+INSET_W+2,py1+INSET_H+2),(0,255,255),2)
    cv2.putText(fr,"ZOOM",(px1+8,py1+26),cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,0.7,(0,255,255),2)
    ff.stdin.write(fr.tobytes())

ff.stdin.close(); ff.wait(); cap.release()
print("written",OUT)
EOF
